about: ONE clip, ONE shot, nothing cut inside: green polo + black cap, greenside bunker on the loosey goosey par 5 — “I don't know how to do these, but for some reason anytime I'm in a bunker I feel I need to bounce, so whatever that means” → swing → the ball goes about six inches → “and you know a lot of you tell me to hit behind the ball, but would you look at that, I just did that, and it went, I don't know, six inches.” Your original sound and captions. Line (smaller, bolder and lower since Oct 17 — above your captions, below the IG top bar): “me listening to the comment section” — fades right after impact as you step toward the camera so it stays off your face. From Video Oct 12 2026, 12 22 39 AM.mov (116.2–129.8 s), which you posted yourself on @mackthegolfer Oct 10 — “LGB LOOSEY GOOSEY BABY #neverforget” https://www.instagram.com/reel/DeUZyg5xywP/ (38 s of it in that post, fingerprint checked). This bunker shot isn't in any other shorty or compilation (asmr only uses its ~1 s contact sound). True original, single crf-17 export; preview copy here.
